meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 将 Flask、Django、FastAPI 等 Python 应用部署到 Azure App Service;缺少资源组、计划或 Web 应用时自动创建,配置启动命令并执行部署,最后返回访问网址。
howto.when: 当你说“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”、“FastAPI App Service”等 App Service 相关短语,或要求把 Python 部署到 App Service 时触发。

say.text: 把 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service。
say.note: 自动建资源并部署,返回访问网址。

say.text: 将 Django 项目部署到 App Service Linux。
say.note: 检测项目并部署,无需额外启动命令。

say.text: 帮我部署 FastAPI 到 Azure App Service。
say.note: 会设置 FastAPI 启动命令后部署。

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) apps to Azure App Service Linux; auto-creates missing resource group/plan/web app, sets startup command and build flag, then deploys and returns the access URL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", or "deploy Python to App Service".

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service.
say_en.note: Creates resources and deploys, returning the URL.

say_en.text: Deploy this Django project to App Service Linux.
say_en.note: Detects the app and deploys it.

say_en.text: Help me deploy FastAPI to Azure App Service.
say_en.note: Sets the FastAPI startup command, then deploys.
